description: This file defines the ApplicationSignalsClient class which extends AwsClient. It provides methods for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals service, including operations like getting and creating service level objectives, listing services, tagging resources, and starting discovery. The methods are annotated for both synchronous and asynchronous invocation.

classes.name: ApplicationSignalsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals service, providing methods for managing service signals, level objectives, dependencies, and tags.

methods.name: batchGetServiceLevelObjectiveBudgetReport
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of service level objective budget reports.

methods.name: createServiceLevelObjective
methods.description: Creates a new service level objective.

methods.name: deleteServiceLevelObjective
methods.description: Deletes an existing service level objective.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific service.

methods.name: getServiceLevelObjective
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific service level objective.

methods.name: listServiceDependencies
methods.description: Lists dependencies of a specific service.

methods.name: listServiceDependents
methods.description: Lists dependents of a specific service.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: startDiscovery
methods.description: Starts the discovery process for service signals.

methods.name: updateServiceLevelObjective
methods.description: Updates an existing service level objective.
